evidence_boundaries.timeline: Paused Web Animations API snapshots prove only the recorded Chrome timeline and DOM state, not subjective smoothness on target hardware.
evidence_boundaries.interruption: One mid-flight reversal proves that reproduced reversal only; rapid retargeting, cancellation, race handling, and other inputs remain unverified.
evidence_boundaries.performance: A short Performance.getMetrics delta is diagnostic evidence, not a frame rate, Core Web Vital, GPU profile, long-session result, or memory-leak proof.
evidence_boundaries.reduced_motion: Media emulation and computed timings prove this fixture's response only; they do not prove platform-wide policy or subjective comfort.
evidence_boundaries.timed_ui: The recorded local timer proves disappearance in this fixture, not user attention, reading completion, or production notification behavior.

checks.note: Continuous decorative motion requires a pause/reduced-motion contract.
Motion contracts should enumerate the exact animated properties.

states.continuity_boundary: Two sampled rectangles do not prove a smooth or velocity-continuous reversal.

checks.note: Large panel translation should become immediate or a non-spatial alternative.

Routine refresh should avoid replaying staged entrance motion.
